rationale: David brings deep expertise in shipping autonomous systems to production (drones, tractors, robots) and is now focused on real-time infrastructure for robotics, while Parth is actively building hardware test engineering for Tesla's humanoid robot program—making this a natural pairing for exploring how software infrastructure and hardware validation intersect in production robotics. David's conviction that purpose-built observability and real-time comms are critical for production systems directly complements Parth's hands-on experience stress-testing hardware at scale.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Parth Behani — David spent years shipping autonomous systems into production (drones, tractors, robots) and now builds real-time infrastructure at LiveKit, while Parth is doing hardware test engineering on Tesla's humanoid robot program, making you both valuable sounding boards on the production robotics side.
